extracted.name: White Chicken Chili with Salsa
extracted.description: This white chicken chili with salsa recipe features tender chicken simmered in the slow cooker with great Northern beans, salsa, and pepper Jack cheese.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 pound pepperjack cheese, cut into chunks
1 (8 ounce) can white meat chicken, shredded
instruction_lines: Combine great Northern beans, salsa, pepper Jack cheese, and chicken in a slow cooker; mix well. Cover the slow cooker.
Cook on Low until cheese has completely melted into chili and flavors have combined, 4 to 5 hours.
